create_chat_completion_vlm: create a chat completion using the OpenAI client to send text and image to a vision-language model
build_openai_client_hf: build an OpenAI client configured with a custom Hugging Face router base URL and HF_TOKEN
run_vlm_image_description: run a vision-language model to describe an image from a URL in one sentence
test_chat_completions_multimodal: test the chat.completions.create API with multimodal messages containing text and image_url
review_completion_response: review the completion response by accessing choices[0].message from the chat completion result
